does: Squeezes a small lump of a soft, cool mixture in the closed fist, so that it takes the print of the fingers and comes out as a small ridged oval, with nothing cooked afterwards.
how: Keep a bowl of water beside the work and wet the hands lightly.
Take a small lump of the mixture and close the fist around it.
Squeeze, so that it presses into an oval along the fingers and takes their marks.
Set it on a platter and go on until the mixture is used.
Keep it cool and serve it cold.

cues.text: Each piece is an even oval with the print of the fingers along it.
The piece holds together when lifted and does not crumble.

mistakes.mistake: Working with dry hands, so that the mixture sticks and tears.
mistakes.fix: Wet the hands lightly and often.

mistakes.mistake: Shaping a mixture that is still loose, so that the pieces slump.
mistakes.fix: Leave it to swell longer, or knead in a little more fine bulgur.

mistakes.mistake: Making the pieces different sizes, which looks untidy on the plate.
mistakes.fix: Take about the same amount each time.

comes_after.why: The mixture is kneaded until it holds before it is shaped.

variant_of.differs: There is no meat and nothing is cooked afterwards. The piece is squeezed in the fist into a ridged oval and not rolled round between the palms, and it is served cold.
